Company Description Ayubi is a growing technology company focused on building reliable, scalable software solutions for a variety of clients. The team values clean, maintainable code and modern engineering practices to deliver high-quality applications. Ayubi provides an environment where engineers can work closely with peers, learn new technologies, and contribute to impactful projects. The company emphasizes collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional growth for all team members.
Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Freelance Software Engineer role based in Bahawalpur. The Software Engineer will design, develop, and maintain back-end services and web applications, ensuring performance, security, and reliability. Day-to-day responsibilities include writing clean, testable code, reviewing code from peers, troubleshooting issues, and implementing new features according to requirements. The role involves collaborating with product and design teams, participating in technical discussions, and contributing to architectural decisions. The engineer will also document solutions, follow best practices, and stay current with relevant tools and frameworks.
Qualifications
Strong foundation in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles.
Proficiency in Software Development and Programming using at least one modern language (e.g., Java, C#, Python, JavaScript).
Experience in Back-End Web Development, including APIs, databases, and server-side frameworks.
Solid understanding and practical use of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts.
Ability to debug and optimize code, write unit and integration tests, and use version control systems (e.g., Git).
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently on-site in Bahawalpur.
Effective communication and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with web technologies, databases (SQL/NoSQL), and familiarity with agile or iterative development methodologies is a plus.

Boeing brings together people, expertise, and technology to help make the world a better place. The company is committed to creating a welcoming, respectful, and inclusive workplace where employees can contribute, grow, and take pride in meaningful work.
Tapestry Solutions, a Boeing company and part of Boeing Global Services, has more than 30 years of experience delivering information technology and business intelligence solutions. Its approximately 500 professionals support defense, commercial, and government clients across more than 50 U.S. locations and nine countries. The team combines the resources of a global aerospace company with the collaborative, people-focused culture of a smaller organization.
About The Company
Tapestry Solutions develops and supports technology that helps customers accomplish important missions. Its employees emphasize ownership, excellence, and practical innovation while supporting the safety and operational needs of customers and colleagues around the world.
About The Role
Boeing is seeking an Entry-Level Software Engineer to join Tapestry Solutions in Maryland Heights, Missouri. In this role, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of weapon-planning software for the U.S. Air Force and the Department of Defense’s next-generation Mission Planning system. You will work as part of a software development Scrum team using the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).
The system uses a microservices architecture, with TypeScript and React for front-end development and primarily C# for back-end services. This position offers an opportunity to build foundational software engineering experience while contributing to products that support critical defense missions. The role is for first shift. Applicants must be able to obtain a U.S. Secret clearance and meet applicable U.S. export control requirements.
Qualifications
Required qualifications include a bachelor’s degree or higher, experience with C#, and the ability to obtain a U.S. Secret security clearance. U.S. citizenship is required to meet the government’s clearance requirements. The position also requires a U.S. Person, as defined by applicable export control regulations. Boeing will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.
Preferred qualifications include a degree in engineering, engineering technology, chemistry, physics, mathematics, data science, or computer science, or equivalent relevant education and experience. Experience with Agile or Scrum, JavaScript or TypeScript, relational databases, and cloud environments such as AWS or C2S is beneficial. Candidates with experience across the software development life cycle are encouraged to apply.
Responsibilities
With general supervision, develop, document, maintain, and unit-test software using development environments and languages such as C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, and React. Apply established methods and practices to create and maintain software designs, and assist with software requirements specification and maintenance.
Investigate defects and operational or integration issues, collect and document relevant information, and collaborate with teammates to recommend solutions. Integrate and compile software components into builds, test component-level software in its target environment, and document deployed processes and tools. Collect project metrics and perform other duties as assigned.
Benefits
Boeing offers a total rewards package designed to attract, engage, and retain talent. Depending on eligibility, benefits generally include health insurance, flexible spending and health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance, and paid and unpaid time away from work. Program availability may vary based on factors such as location and hire date.
The summary base pay range for this position is $65,000 to $72,680. Pay is determined based on a candidate’s experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. Relocation assistance is not available. This is a drug-free workplace; post-offer applicants and employees may be subject to testing as outlined in company policy. Applications are expected to be accepted until November 7, 2026.
Equal Opportunity
Boeing is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

China produces about 85% of the world's cathode active material. The West needs new battery chemistries to compete, but traditional R&D can take years to deliver them. 
 
Today, we announced $45M in funding to change that. 
 
Backed by  Zone II Ventures, and Course Corrected, we're scaling our AI-powered Discovery Engine, which combines 18 years of proprietary battery data with automated labs that physically build and test new materials. Over these 18 years our platform has run more than 225 projects for more than 85 customers across the battery value chain, including nearly a dozen Fortune 500 companies, and has resulted in more than 100 battery patents.  Along the way, the platform generated an internally consistent dataset covering more than 500,000 physical cells tested at over 165 million cycles.  
 
Our technology has already helped deliver DRX, a new family of nickel- and cobalt-free cathode materials designed to reduce dependence on China. Now, we're bringing DRX toward commercialization while using AI to accelerate the next generation of breakthroughs. 
 
Led by founder and CEO Mathias Ingvarsson, COO and former Tesla manufacturing leader Steven Prast, and Chief Scientific Officer Dee Strand, we're building a faster path from battery discovery to commercial deployment. 
 
Read more in Fortune by Nick Lichtenberg. Article link in the first comment.

BREAKING: Brookfield announces HUGE $27 BILLION AI data centre project in the UK! 

Brookfield has partnered with British energy company Drax Group and AI business Radiant to develop one of the UK’s largest AI data centres at Drax Power Station in the north of England. 

Bloomberg reports that the project could attract more than $27 Billion billion in investment, with an initial $3.3 Billion planned for the first phase, backed by Brookfield’s partnership with the Qatar Investment Authority.

The idea is to build the data centre alongside an existing power station, giving it access to the enormous amounts of electricity needed to run AI technology. Drax CEO Will Gardiner said: “If constructed in full, this project could become one of the largest data centres in the UK.” Brookfield's Connor Teskey recently said of AI infrastructure: "there is no shortage of capital - and there is no shortage of demand."

Big news for European AI infrastructure!

Follow Joseph Cass for finance news and insights.
